symptom: describe microflow printed only one of two notes: Note2, wired to two activities, came out as @annotation(id: n1, …); Note1 was missing entirely, so describe -> exec deleted it. Reported as 'annotations not linked to an activity are missing'.
cause: collectFreeAnnotations called a note free only when NO AnnotationFlow originated from it, and buildAnnotationsByTarget files a note under its flow's destination, which the traversal prints only for statements. A note whose only link ends at the StartEvent or at another Annotation was therefore neither free nor printed.
insight: The literal reading of the report - a note with no link at all - already round-tripped; reproducing it as stated passes on HEAD. Enumerate the link ends the describer has no statement for (start event, another note, a link drawn element -> note) and build each: two of them vanish. The fix leans on an existing coupling worth knowing: useDerivedFlowLayout keeps the first statement's @position whenever collectFreeAnnotations is non-empty, because the visitor reads `@annotation(text:…)` as free only when activity metadata follows it - so widening collectFreeAnnotations also keeps the canonical describe unambiguous. The link itself has no MDL form; the describer says so in a -- WARNING line rather than dropping it silently. A start-event note link would need new syntax.
